description: Get any object by ID (pty_, off_, ned_, mch_, int_, apr_, clm_, drf_) in the version you may see. A match includes the criteria breakdown and all interactions; an interaction includes request, response and answer_format. For the owner's own party, offering or need pass `view_as` to preview what others see — show it to the owner before publishing.

id.description: Any platform ID; the prefix tells the type: pty party, off offering, ned need, mch match, int interaction, apr approval, clm claim, drf draft.

view_as.description: Only for your own objects: preview at this visibility level.

name: get_details
title: Get any object by ID
